title: Smart Data Models - RealEstateCore - Organization
description: An organization of any sort (e.g., a business, association, project, consortium, tribe, etc.) (rec:Organization, RealEstateCore 4.1, definition verbatim). Company and Department are carried in recClass.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Organization'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Human-readable name (REC 'name' in DTDL, rdfs:label in the SHACL source).

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. A description of this item. Not a REC term.

identifiers.description: Property. Map of external identifiers for this entity, keyed by the namespace/system that issued them (REC 'identifiers', DTDL Map<string,string>).

customTags.description: Property. Map of free-form boolean tags (REC 'customTags', DTDL Map<string,boolean>).

customProperties.description: Property. Namespaced extension properties: a map from namespace to a map of property name to string value (REC 'customProperties', DTDL Map<string,Map<string,string>>).

recClass.description: Relationship. The specific RealEstateCore class of this entity (rdf:type), as the class IRI. REC 4.1 declares 3 non-deprecated classes in the rec:Organization hierarchy (this class and all its subclasses), all allowed here: Company; Department; Organization.

logo.description: Property. URL of an image/logo that represents the organization (rec:logo).

hasMember.description: Relationship. Agents (Persons or Organizations) that are members of this organization. Membership, not componency.

hasPart.description: Relationship. Organizational parts, e.g. departments of a corporation.

isPartOf.description: Relationship. Organizations this organization is a part of (componency, e.g. a department of a company).

memberOf.description: Relationship. Organizations this organization is a member of (rec:memberOf, new in REC 4.1; replaces the deprecated isMemberOf, which is not included here).

owns.description: Relationship. Things owned by this organization, e.g. Buildings, Assets, other Organizations (rec:owns).
